全國ラヂオ調査報告 1934

Zenkoku rajio chōsa hōkoku (National Radio Survey Report), 第1回 (first survey, published 1934)
遞信省 (Ministry of Communications) and 日本放送協會 (Broadcasting Corporation of Japan), 東京, 1934

Every statistical table and the tables in the summary chapters are transcribed, and the request classification is transcribed as directory entries; the prose and the 33 coloured chart plates are not. Each spread was read once by Claude Sonnet 5.5 from full-resolution crops, with no checking by eye; the very long tables (4, 6 and 7) were read in four-frame instalments and joined, so a table may consist of many parts. Unreadable figures are [?]; printed totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted.
